editorSevenTabProven.covers: All seven 생활 tabs (crops, characters, lifeCrafting, dailyWeather, farmAnimals, farmSpatial, lifeCollections) at 1024x768 and 1440x900 on the real editor, each asserted to render a non-empty authoring surface; 14 screenshots captured.
editorSevenTabProven.project: rpg-zzu-life-full-01a08046-verify (the isolated remote row from task 19) — never the shared demo row.
editorSevenTabProven.whyThisSurfaceWorked: The e2e helper switchDatabaseTab already expands a collapsed sidebar group (revealCollapsedSidebarTab), which is exactly the activation the runtime harness could not perform.
diagnosisNotes: First failure was the dev server: playwright webServer timeout is 30s and a cold Vite start exceeds it, so nothing was served. Started the server first and polled it to HTTP 200.
Second failure was the remote row being pruned mid-session, so the editor had no project to load. Re-saved and re-ran. Neither was a spec defect.

shippingAndResumeProven.result: 2 tests pass. Journey: 생활 장부 열기 -> 출하 투입 -> 수면 -> 하루 전환 -> 정산 -> 저장 -> 로드 재개.
shippingAndResumeProven.settlementEvidence: BEFORE {day:1, gold:0} -> AFTER {day:2, gold:28}. The 28G matches exactly the 예상 단가 28G the ledger showed for 야생 부추, so the deposited item settled at its own price. Screenshot 12-settled-gold.png independently shows 1년 봄 2일 06:00 and 돈 28G.
shippingAndResumeProven.depositEvidence: The withdraw entry life-ledger-shipping-withdraw-item_wild_leek appears only when queued>0 (lifeLedger.ts:826), so its presence proves the deposit mutated state.
shippingAndResumeProven.resumeEvidence: load-slot-1 reads 비어 있음 before saving and 저장됨 after, then loading it returns to play with the runtime alive.
shippingAndResumeProven.rootCauseOfEarlierFailures: NOT a harness limitation, as I had recorded. scripts/qa/runtime drives input via injectActionEdge() into the PHASER key manager, while the status menu is DOM and listens for window keydown (input.ts comments say exactly this). The plan already named playwright.runtime.config.ts and status-menu-adversarial.spec.ts already drove this menu. Using the prescribed harness opened the rail immediately.
falseAssumptionsCorrected: group entries use status-menu-group-command-<id>, not status-menu-command-<id>
cold Vite compile needs >45s for the first title screen
shipping entries are keyboard onActivate entries, not click targets
Escape is 뒤로/toggle, not close — keyBindings.ts: menu open/close is the same key as cancel, so a repeat loop reopened the menu
the bed is ev_bed at map_farming_demo (3,3) — my map_farm/(5,3) teleport failed silently and minute 0->1 was mistaken for a day change
entry.disabled never reaches the DOM (playerStatusMenu.ts:380), so toBeDisabled() was unprovable

retractedClaims.claim: notYetProven.shippingAndSettlement said shipping was BLOCKED on menu activation after seven attempts.
retractedClaims.status: RETRACTED — false. Shipping deposit and settlement are now proven (day 1 gold 0 -> day 2 gold 28, matching the ledger 예상 단가 28G).
retractedClaims.cause: I was using scripts/qa/runtime, which injects edges into the Phaser key manager, while the status menu is DOM and listens for window keydown. The prescribed harness (playwright.runtime.config.ts) opens the rail immediately.
retractedClaims.lesson: I recorded an environment limitation before exhausting the tooling the plan itself specified.
